The comparison uses the PC card image of [[Colonel Jendon In Vader's Personal Shuttle]] (dated 5 March 2023, [[:File:V21-D-coloneljendoninvaderspersonalshuttle.gif|V21-D-coloneljendoninvaderspersonalshuttle.gif]]); the second image is the slip of this version, cut unchanged from page 4 of the [[Media:Virtual Set 21 June 2023 (recovered).pdf|Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition]] (rendered at 200 dpi).
